name: Rubescent-Barrow
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in orbital debris ring. Travelers navigate by towering mountain ranges and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
The air carries ammonia and old snow, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.

The terrain around starship crash site (warship) is scarred for kilometers, and the wreck's black box still loops two seconds of static on an obsolete band. Insurance investigators consider it a haunted assignment.
There is money in iron and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
